caption: The drawing displays two primary objects on a plain, light-colored background. The upper object is a brown sheath, rectangular with rounded edges, likely made of leather, featuring a small flap or attachment on its upper left edge. Below the sheath lies a large knife, positioned at a slight angle. The knife has a wide, straight-edged blade with a rounded tip, depicted in a metallic grey color, and displays darker patches suggesting spots of discoloration or wear. The handle of the knife is light brown with a textured appearance, resembling wood or antler, and the butt of the handle is dark. There is a small, dark guard separating the blade from the handle. The composition places the sheath and knife parallel to each other, both centered on the page. The name "Albert Bailly" is inscribed in small script to the lower right of the objects.
title: Knife and Sheath
